context: Operator answered "y" to item 1 of the path-to-accuracy recommendation, approving the scorecard rulings page (no answers had been saved on the page) and the historical-run readings. Orchestrator interpretation, stated to the operator: every page item as recommended; F-SH-12/F-SH-13 follow the City reading only where the by-law text supports it; front yard keeps M-245 with the needs-survey guard.

decisions.subject: Key the five exceptions that have no units yet (x40, x225, x478, x863, x559). Two of them say "Site Specific Provisions: (None Apply)", so they only need their prevailing units.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Measured effect: 13 NO ANSWER rows become answerable. Keyed through the normal keyer-A/B + agree path; x40/x225 need PREVAILING units only. Source: ch900_3.txt, ch900_5.txt, ch900_6.txt.

decisions.subject: Fix a reference bug: "Despite regulations 10.80.40.70(1) to (3)" must displace (1), (2) and (3), not just the two endpoints.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — xref.mjs GROUP_TAIL (line 83) accepts "to" as SEP (line 68) does, expanded with expandRange (line 97). R/RS/RT already expand their relative "(1) to (n) above".

decisions.subject: Key the RM apartment side yard like its R/RD/RS/RT twins: 2.4 m. The 5.5 m (walls with main windows) becomes a disclosed design choice, and the 7.5 m (walls past 25 m length) goes to the deep-side target.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Re-key 10.80.40.70(4)(D): side_setback_m = 2.4 m @(D)(i); (ii) disclosed design-choice arm like M-197; (iii) deep_side_setback_m like RD 10.20.40.70(5) under M-205(2).

decisions.subject: Floor-area formula for exception RD 42: 118 m² + 25% of lot area, capped at FSI 0.5, using the smaller of the two.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — 900.3.10(42)(A)(i): gfa_m2 = min(118 m2 + 25 pct × lot_area_m2; 0.5 ratio × lot_area_m2).

decisions.subject: The RD 70 side yard (1.8 m, plus 0.6 m per extra storey) applies to the house only, with the storey increment keyed. Garages and pavilions fall back to the general rule: half their height.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Scope 900.3.10(70)(B) to the residential building; side_setback_m = 1.8 m + 0.6 m × (height_storeys − 1), OWED on height_storeys. Ancillary falls to 10.5.60.20(3)(C)(ii), OWED on proposed_height_m.

decisions.subject: Reading question. Does the 2025 "more permissive regulation prevails" rule (10.80.30.1(2)) override an exception's own "35% for a duplex or triplex"?
decisions.recommendation: Follow the City (exception 35% applies) — If ruled the City's way: M-180(2) reading narrowed for exception clauses naming the building type; vocab.exception_type_alias gains duplex/triplex → houseplex-by-unit-count.

decisions.subject: Garden-suite lots: keep the house's coverage answer, and also put the 20% "all ancillary buildings combined" cap on ancillary coverage. Show the 45% "all buildings" route as the alternative.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — 150.7.60.70(1)(B): ancillary_coverage_pct ≤ 20 (all ancillary buildings incl. the garden suite); (A) 45% disclosed as the alternative path.

decisions.subject: Interim, before full deck modelling: a deck or porch must meet the zone's setbacks (10.5.40.50(2)), keyed as a pointer to the house setbacks. Apply the approved D-3 max-plus-clearance form to the whole 10.5.40.60 family, so porch and stair clearances (0.3 m, 0.6 m) get answers.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Key 10.5.40.50(2) as an element-scoped reference to side/rear/front_setback_m; extend the M-239 declared-bound form (D-3) to 10.5.40.60(1)–(8).

decisions.subject: Key the rules the City enforces but we do not: the RD 19 m length extension (3.0 m from each side), the RD parapet +0.3 m, the platform count, the suite stair rule, and the missing 1.5 m soft-landscaping strip (10.5.50.10(5)).
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Triage each UNUSUAL/PERMIT unit against its text; 10.20.40.20(2)(C) is a plain minimum on the extension; add the 10.5.50.10(5) unit.

decisions.subject: After the floor removal, measure averaging accuracy properly. Treat front yards as "needs survey" wherever our neighbour estimate is missing or excluded, rather than falling back to 6.0 m.
decisions.recommendation: Approve — Where averaging applies but no qualifying neighbour estimate exists, answer front_setback_m as needs_survey (never the zone default), and re-measure after M-205(1)-floor lands.

decisions.subject: RD side-yard band chosen from the lot's actual frontage (City examiner reading) rather than the label minimum frontage
decisions.recommendation: Follow the City examiner's reading where the by-law text supports it (10.20.40.70(3) bands keyed on actual lot frontage); if the text does not support it, draft a ruling instead of changing code.

decisions.subject: Rear-yard soft landscaping on lots 6.0 m wide or less: City 50 %, ours 25 % (branch (B))
decisions.recommendation: Follow the City examiner's reading where the by-law text of 10.5.50.10(3) supports it; if the text does not support it, draft a ruling instead of changing code.

decisions.subject: Front-yard floor: keep M-245 (no floor) with a needs-survey guard
decisions.recommendation: Keep the floor removed (M-245) and add the needs-survey guard: where averaging applies but no qualifying neighbour estimate exists or estimates are excluded, front_setback_m answers needs_survey, never the zone default; report the too-generous rate before/after.
